speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I am Dr. Agent. You are here because of a fever and abdominal pain after giving birth; tell me, when exactly did your delivery occur, and is this your first time?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum endometritis.

The combination of postpartum fever, uterine tenderness, and a prolonged labor course is highly suggestive of endometritis. I will proceed with further evaluation to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other causes like a urinary tract infection or retained products of conception.
